about: Corrections to the building ids that scripts/spatial-import.ts derives from building.shp (see src/modules/spatial/building-ids.ts). The footprints are unchanged. An existing database is renamed with scripts/building-ids-rename.ts.

ids.name: 혜인관
ids.reason: This 1,512 m2 polygon carries the name 혜인관 in the file, but it is a duplicate lying on the 혜인관 site (the scene source calls it 공연실습소 and the scene hides it); the user confirmed on 2026-10-10 that 공연실습소 is a separate building elsewhere. It must not hold the id of the real building.

ids.name: 혜인관
ids.reason: The unnamed 1,933 m2 polygon is the real 혜인관 (register 42232; building metadata, the scene source and the university map all call it 혜인관). Roads and places inside it were stored under the placeholder id 건물5.
